topic: 10 Things I Wish I Knew Before Starting ML
headline: 10 things I wish I knew before starting ML. Real lessons. Not textbook advice.
caption:
When I started my ML journey, I had no idea what I was getting into.

The tutorials made it look easy. The reality was... different.

After months of building, breaking, and rebuilding real ML projects, here are 10 raw, honest lessons nobody teaches you upfront — for beginners AND experienced engineers.

Slide through. I promise at least one of these will hit you.

💬 What's the one thing YOU wish you knew before starting ML? Drop it below 👇
